4700.scope: Report §§1-6 synthesized as one mathematical narrative; theorem scopes and proof routes linked, not reproved here.

4701.scope: Defines compact-time trajectory convergence and proves extension uniqueness and inherited group property.

4702.scope: Variational derivative, skew bracket, conservation identity and the integral Casimir are computed on Schwartz functions.

4703.scope: Full variation and integration-by-parts proof, with P=one half of the squared L2 norm.

4704.scope: Finite-dimensional C3 Hessian calculation and ODE pushforward argument; PDE existence is a separate cited input.

4705.scope: Chain rule and uniqueness establish exact flow factorization on common smooth domains.

4706.scope: Defines uniform translation continuity for bounded families and distinguishes time equicontinuity.

4707.scope: Full Plancherel proof in both directions, using an explicitly integrated exponential average.

4708.scope: Frequency splitting proves Cauchy convergence and the converse, including parameter-uniform variant.

4709.scope: L2 tail definition; equivalence with the stated bounded cutoff weight is proved.

4710.scope: Line H^-1 theorem, uniform two-derivative local-smoothing bound and continuity on each fixed translated spacetime window; periodic sharp L2 result is cited through the introduction, not independently reproved.

4711.scope: Defines continuous-frequency Hardy subspace and proves projection identities; circle Hardy page retained only as comparison.

4712.scope: Defines epsilon convention, Hardy constraint and critical mass scaling; no regularity theorem proved here.

4713.scope: Defocusing all L2_+; focusing mass strictly below 2pi from Theorems 1.4 and 1.6; explicit-formula proof separated from forthcoming commuting-flow work.

4714.scope: Full differential algebra with real smooth input; no inverse or low-regularity equivalence asserted.

4715.scope: Two-term subtraction and absorption prove the precise conditional parameter estimate.

4716.scope: Exact L2 difference identity plus integrating-factor Gronwall proof on smooth solutions.

4717.scope: Quotes Proposition 3.1 evolution; chain rule derives reciprocal density and the vanishing-at-infinity flux constant.

4718.scope: Two-parameter cancellation and norm-upgrade steps supplied; Proposition 4.4 nonlinear asymptotic and Proposition 2.2 bi-Lipschitz estimates remain cited inputs.

4719.scope: Fourier Cauchy-Schwarz embedding, product derivative estimate and duality prove the multiplier bound.

470A.scope: Inner/outer split and tightness prove the compact-time uniform result.

470B.scope: Every differential-operator commutator is expanded on common compactly supported tests; no unbounded unitary-propagator theorem asserted.

470C.scope: Distributional jump calculation, Fourier multiplier and positive square-root multiplier.

470D.scope: Exact Fourier kernel calculation with nonunitary Fourier normalization, convolution integral, and dense extension.

470E.scope: Defines alpha via absolutely convergent traces for HS norm below one; det2 notation introduced locally.

470F.scope: Geometric-series trace estimate yields explicit one-sixth and five-sixths bounds when HS norm is at most one quarter.

470G.scope: Conserved determinant coercivity is cited; weighted Fourier-tail equivalence and propagation are proved locally.

470H.scope: Quadratic expansion and cancellation computed; cubic coefficient and differentiable higher remainder cited for fixed Schwartz data.

470I.scope: Exact vector field and Duhamel formula derived; local mechanism explained; global conservation and commutation cited from Proposition 3.2.

470J.scope: Small real H^-1 ball, kappa>=1, continuous kernel and analytic diffeomorphisms onto images stated; the first coordinate derivative is -kappa^{-1}R and the second is -2*kappa*R, with the normalization derived by the chain rule.

470K.scope: Resolvent identity, diagonal variation, and trace series calculation proved for small Schwartz potentials; rough extension cited.

470L.scope: Substitution of the zero-potential Green derivative yields regularized and difference multipliers exactly.

470M.scope: Abstract Banach Cauchy extension proof with D-invariant auxiliary flows; diagonal density argument proves continuity.

470N.scope: Local momentum conservation and weighted identity fully derived; full Kato smoothing estimate is not deduced here.

470O.scope: Exact Theorem 1.5 weight and family-dependence stated; Proposition 1.11 obstruction cited, without redoing the deep smoothing proof.

470P.scope: Explains separate original-flow and difference-flow smoothing, frequency tails, finite-time tightness, and the abstract extension step.

470Q.scope: Fourier change of variables proves scaling exponent; model equations are examples, not prerequisites of the general formula.

470R.scope: Real line and circle s>=-1, continuous extension, all-time bounded equicontinuous H^-1 orbits; distributional line result stated separately.

470S.scope: Real-valued s>-1/2 on both geometries; periodic endpoint obstruction and report-bound open line endpoint distinguished.

470T.scope: Defines equation, energy sign and free evolution; verifies scaling by substitution.

470U.scope: Defines complex Hirota mKdV, real restriction and signs; distinguishes |q|^2 q_x from derivative of |q|^2 q.

470V.scope: Both signs, all s>-1/2, no small mass; complex norm inflation for s<=-1/2 is separately cited.

470W.scope: Both signs real/complex s>-1/2; complex endpoint small-to-large inflation; real focusing A.3 bounded homogeneous endpoint data and stricter subcritical inflation.

470X.scope: Full mass-current calculation and critical scaling; equation normalization fixed.

470Y.scope: Arbitrary finite L2 mass, all s>=0, continuous local L3 dependence and distributional solution property.

470Z.scope: All variational derivatives and coefficients are calculated by integration by parts.

remaining_branches: Report extensions and unread deep proofs are enumerated at packet level.
unexpanded_deep_proofs: Small-H^-1 closed Schrödinger operator, analytic Green-coordinate inverse, and full nonlinear resolvent estimates.
Full low-regularity existence proofs, periodic KdV implementation and primary ill-posedness constructions except selected Appendix A reading.
BO new gauge and hierarchy Lax structure.
NLS/mKdV/dNLS/fifth-order frequency-localized smoothing and difference-flow estimates.
CCM explicit formula and compactness proof; endpoint and blowup studies.
